messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Great! Now let's address the network type issue. Since you're on a 2G network, which is very slow, you need to change your network mode preference to allow your phone to connect to faster networks like 4G and 5G.

Please perform this action on your phone:

**set_network_mode_preference(mode="4g_5g_preferred")**

This will change your phone's preference to connect to 4G and 5G networks instead of being stuck on 2G. After you do this, let me know when it's complete, and we'll check your network status again to see if you've connected to a faster network.

I have set the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred on my phone. What would you like me to do next?

Please summarize the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
